hook: One place for the pieces of your health history.
thumbnail: Your health, all in one place
caption: Your health history shouldn't live in five different apps. Sleep, meals, medication, symptoms, measurements, documents, one place that actually connects them. Explore HealthGraph. #healthgraph #healthtimeline #selftracking #healthdiary #wellnessjournal #digitaldiary #pulsehealth #healthtech #mindfultracking #connectedhealth

lines.text: One place for the pieces of your health history.
lines.beat: explore grid montage: 20 health-area tiles ripple into place over warm charcoal, healthgraph graph-pulse mark settles top, voice FAB pulse visible

lines.text: Sleep. Nutrition. Medication. Symptoms. Measurements. Documents.
lines.beat: fast succession, one tile per word: sleep, nutrition ring, medication card, symptom map, pulse result, document cards, each a masked reveal

lines.text: Usually they live scattered across five different places.
lines.beat: fragmented objects float: PDF, NOTE, MEDICATION, SYMPTOM, MEASUREMENT, MEAL cards drift apart in depth layers

lines.text: HealthGraph keeps them side by side.
lines.beat: all fragment cards are pulled into one HEALTHGRAPH hub node, green edges draw between them

lines.text: A pulse reading on your fingertip, saved and synced.
lines.beat: pulse-measurement screen: green sensor trace draws, 67 BPM FINGERTIP gauge at 58 percent, Saved and synced chip

lines.text: Estimated calories from today's scans, clearly marked as estimates.
lines.beat: nutrition-calories screen: ring fills to 977 of 3000 kcal, Scans estimate. Not measured, not a target. line

lines.text: Mood, sleep, and meals from a single daily log.
lines.beat: daily-log screen: mood Very good, sleep 7h, recent history row with 3 events

lines.text: Documents uploaded once, kept with everything else.
lines.beat: records-upload screen: teal upload button, PDF PNG JPG file cards dock into Past uploads

lines.text: And the timeline shows how each day connects to the next.
lines.beat: health-graph screen: camera drags through time across 12 nodes and 22 connections, legend Event Visit Heart Sleep Nutrition
end card: healthgraph wordmark centered, Explore HealthGraph
